label: Messenger
terms_note: Free; pages_messaging + pages_show_list, pages_manage_metadata, pages_read_engagement, business_management; App Review for Advanced Access except when the app only messages for its OWN Facebook Page; a business must reply within the 24-hour standard messaging window (message tags / sponsored messages outside it); volume + throughput limits exist and heavy sending can temporarily disable the inbox; automatic replies, live-agent handover or both are explicitly allowed.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (inbox / conversations only — no public feed).
auth: 1. Meta app with the Messenger product; Page access token with `pages_messaging` plus `pages_show_list`,
2. Subscribe the Page to the app's webhook (`messages`, `messaging_postbacks`, `message_reads`, `messaging_handovers`).
3. App Review for Advanced Access is required **unless the app only messages for its own Page**.
4. Instagram Messaging rides the same platform for Instagram Professional accounts (`instagram_manage_messages`).

endpoints.purpose: hand to the Page Inbox for a human

reference.limits: - 24-hour standard messaging window after the user's last message; message tags / sponsored messages beyond it. - Volume + throughput limits; high-volume sending "can temporarily disable inbox functionality". - Free. Businesses may run automatic replies, live agents, or both (explicitly allowed). - No user-account automation — everything is Page-scoped.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/send-messages now redirects to https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/messenger-platform/send-messages, 'Send a message - Messenger Platform'): Messenger is 1:1 Page-to-person messaging (Send API POST /{page-id}/messages inside the 24-hour window, conversations via GET /{page-id}/conversations) with no public feed, so no social verb (public post, comments, mentions, post analytics) has an endpoint. Messenger is served in the messaging category (catalog/messaging/messenger.json); Page feed posts are served by catalog/social/facebook.json.
